Free. Strict mode, 2 schedules, Reels and Shorts hiding, breath and swap, 1 key holder.
Cancel in one tap on Google Play. Google Play reminds you by email before a subscription renews.
Your plan, focus sessions, intercept times, flashcards, study tasks and energy check-ins. Accessibility only looks for Reels and Shorts sections during your blocks; it never stores what is on screen.

Plan rules (distractions, schedules, key holder name, unlock settings, blocked sites), and focus session start and end times with intercept and unlock counts. Unlock requests send the reason you type to your key holder.
Screen contents, messages, browsing or watch history, which videos you opened, flashcards, tasks, or minute-by-minute usage.

This erases your plan, focus sessions, unlock requests, key-holder links and subscription record from Steady\'s server, and signs you out. Everything on this phone stays as it is. This can\'t be undone.
